explanation: Only a few metals, chiefly iron, nickel and cobalt, are strongly magnetic. Copper, aluminium and brass are not, so a magnet will not stick to an aluminium drinks can.

claims.text: A fridge magnet sticks to iron, which is ferromagnetic.
A fridge magnet does not stick to copper, aluminium or brass.
Only a few metals, chiefly iron, nickel and cobalt, are strongly magnetic (ferromagnetic) at room temperature.
A magnet does not stick to an aluminium drinks can.
